"绿水青山就是金山银山"在生态学上，对应哪种价值逻辑？

Ecologically, what value logic does "lucid waters and lush mountains are gold and silver" map to?

它对应"生态系统服务"与"自然资本"思想：清洁水源、固碳、生物多样性等生态功能本身就值钱，保护不是发展的对立面，而是可持续收益的来源。
It maps to ecosystem services and natural capital: clean water, carbon storage and biodiversity have real value, so protection is not the opposite of development but a source of lasting returns.

防风林带为什么能"挡"住风沙——它的科学原理是什么？

How do shelterbelts physically block wind and sand?

林带降低近地面风速，使风中挟带的沙尘在林前林下落下；多条带"网格式"布局还能把风切成小股、减少起沙，相当于给农田加了缓冲层。
Belts slow near-ground wind so carried dust drops before and inside them; a grid of belts splits wind into weaker streams and reduces sand lift—a buffer for farmland.

中国的"天然林保护"和人工造林，为什么侧重点不同？

Why do China's "natural forest protection" and plantation differ in focus?

天然林保护重在"别再砍、让其自我恢复"，保的是原生结构与生物多样性；人工造林重在快速增绿固碳，两者互补而非互相替代。
Natural forest protection stops logging and lets forests heal, preserving native structure and diversity; plantations quickly add green and carbon. They complement, not replace, each other.

塞罕坝从荒漠变成森林，最关键做对了什么？

What did Saihanba do right to turn desert into forest?

它不是"种一棵活一棵"的奇迹，而是几代人用耐寒树种、机械整地和科学管护，先把土壤保住再逐步恢复植被；说明生态修复需要长期主义和适配物种。
It wasn't a one-shot miracle but generations using cold-hardy species, mechanized land prep and scientific management—stabilizing soil first, then restoring vegetation. It shows restoration needs the long term and the right species.

为什么治沙的逻辑会从"沙进人退"变成"人进沙退"？

Why did desert control shift from "sand advances, people retreat" to "people advance, sand retreats"?

早期主要靠被动躲避，后来转向主动固定流沙、恢复植被、发展沙产业，让人能在修复中获益，从而把对抗变为可持续的共处。
Early efforts only retreated; later ones actively fixed moving sand, restored vegetation and built a sand economy, letting people benefit from restoration and turning conflict into coexistence.

库布其沙漠治沙为什么能"沙里淘金"？

Why can Kubuqi desert control turn sand into income?

治沙不只是种树，还结合了光伏板遮阴固沙、甘草等沙生药材种植、沙漠旅游，让修复本身产生收益；生态改善与经济增收形成正向循环。
Controlling sand means more than planting trees—solar panels shade and fix sand, sand-tolerant herbs like licorice are grown, and desert tourism pays. Restoration itself earns income, creating a positive loop.

三北防护林为什么被称为中国的"绿色长城"？

Why is the Three-North Shelter Forest called China's "Great Green Wall"?

它从东北到西北、华北横跨十余省区，像一道林带墙阻挡风沙、保护农田与村庄；是世界上规模最大的生态造林工程，故称"绿色长城"。
Stretching across more than ten provinces from northeast to northwest and north China, it forms a wall of trees blocking wind and sand and shielding farms and villages—the world's largest afforestation project, hence the name.
